_metadata.description: Expose node identity/trust/reach seam so a future remote-desktop scenario reuses it rather than reimplementing.

requirements.title: remote-desktop Integration Seam
requirements.description: A future remote-desktop scenario (real-time screen/input control via WebRTC/RDP/VNC) reuses bridge's node identity, trust, and reach layer rather than reimplementing it, while owning its own streaming. Bridge exposes the identity/reach seam it needs.

validation.notes: A stable identity/reach query exposes a node's trust state and reachable endpoint for a consuming scenario without leaking job-execution privileges.
A consuming scenario can resolve which nodes are trusted and how to reach them via the documented seam.
